Complete.summary: Routes a completion request to whichever AI provider/model best fits, normalising the response. POST https://api.web6.oasisomniverse.one/v1/complete

OpenServModels.summary: Lists the models reachable through the OpenServ provider (provider: "openserv"), i.e. the full SERV catalog spanning OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, Qwen and DeepSeek behind one SERV_API_KEY. GET https://api.web6.oasisomniverse.one/v1/openserv/models

Embed.summary: Generates embeddings for one or more texts via the configured provider (OpenAI, Cohere, or HuggingFace). Returns float arrays suitable for semantic search, RAG pipelines, or cosine-similarity comparisons. POST https://api.web6.oasisomniverse.one/v1/embed

Solve.summary: FAHRN hero endpoint — full pipeline in one call: auto-classify task type, inject avatar context (Web4+Web5), look up Holonic BRAID graph, dispatch to the reasoning network, return the answer with full reasoning trace and telemetry. POST https://api.web6.oasisomniverse.one/v1/fahrn/solve

BudgetEstimate.summary: Dry-run budget estimate — returns projected token count and cost for a dispatch using the model pricing table, without making any actual agent calls. GET https://api.web6.oasisomniverse.one/v1/fahrn/budget-estimate

GetGraph.summary: Looks up the shared reasoning graph already generated for a task type, if any.

SaveGraph.summary: Seeds the shared library with a reasoning graph for a task type (the "generator" step of the two-stage BRAID protocol).

GetEarthHolon.summary: Returns the root Earth holon at the top of the fractal Holonic BRAID memory hierarchy (Session → Agent → User → Group → ... → Earth).

GetOrCreateHolon.summary: Creates or retrieves a holon at the specified level in the fractal hierarchy.

SetMembraneRule.summary: Sets the membrane rule that governs which memory items are permitted to propagate upward from this holon to its parent.

RecordMemory.summary: Records a memory item into the specified holon.

Propagate.summary: Propagates whatever the child holon's membrane rule permits up to its parent (a single hop).

PropagateUp.summary: Multi-hop upward propagation — propagates permitted memory items up the fractal hierarchy for up to N hops. Pass levels=2147483647 to propagate all the way to Earth.

SearchMemory.summary: Semantic search across all memory items in a holon — returns the top-K items most similar to the query string using cosine similarity over stored embedding vectors.

Generate.summary: Generates an image via the requested provider (StabilityAI or OpenAI). POST https://api.web6.oasisomniverse.one/v1/images/generate

RegisterAdapter.summary: Registers an external orchestrator (MCP, A2A, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or any generic webhook) with WEB6's unified interface.

Invoke.summary: Invokes a registered orchestrator adapter with a payload.

RegisterAgent.summary: Registers a new reasoning agent (e.g. a specific provider/model) with FAHRN.

GetAgents.summary: Lists every reasoning agent currently registered with FAHRN, with its live composite scoring metadata.

SeedOpenServAgents.summary: Seeds FAHRN with one reasoning agent per model in the OpenServ SERV catalog. Safe to call repeatedly. POST https://api.web6.oasisomniverse.one/v1/reasoning-network/agents/seed-openserv

Dispatch.summary: Dispatches a problem to the reasoning network. The controller agent scores eligible agents, picks Serial/Parallel/Decomposed/Debate/Voting execution, runs loop detection, assembles the final Mermaid plan and updates every involved agent's score via EMA before returning.

CreateDid.summary: Creates or retrieves the DID document for the authenticated avatar. POST https://api.web6.oasisomniverse.one/v1/auth/did

ResolveDid.summary: Resolves a DID document from the Universal Resolver. GET https://api.web6.oasisomniverse.one/v1/auth/did/{did}

IssueVc.summary: Issues a W3C Verifiable Credential for the authenticated avatar. POST https://api.web6.oasisomniverse.one/v1/auth/vc

VerifyVc.summary: Verifies a Verifiable Credential issued by this system. Returns { valid: boolean }. POST https://api.web6.oasisomniverse.one/v1/auth/vc/verify

GetProviders.summary: Lists all external memory providers registered and configured via environment variables (Mem0, Zep, Letta, LangMem, Graphiti, Redis Vector). GET https://api.web6.oasisomniverse.one/v1/memory/external/providers

Search.summary: Searches one or more external memory providers for memories relevant to the query. POST https://api.web6.oasisomniverse.one/v1/memory/external/search

Add.summary: Adds a memory to the specified external memory provider. POST https://api.web6.oasisomniverse.one/v1/memory/external/add

Delete.summary: Deletes a specific memory entry from an external memory provider. DELETE https://api.web6.oasisomniverse.one/v1/memory/external/{provider}/{id}

ListModels.summary: Lists deployed in-process ML.NET models and their capabilities (task_classifier, loop_anomaly, sentiment_analysis). GET https://api.web6.oasisomniverse.one/v1/ml/models

ClassifyTask.summary: Classifies the task type of a problem string using the in-process ML.NET model. Returns { taskType: string }. POST https://api.web6.oasisomniverse.one/v1/ml/classify-task

AnalyseSentiment.summary: Analyses sentiment of the provided text. Returns { sentiment: 'Positive' | 'Neutral' | 'Negative' }. POST https://api.web6.oasisomniverse.one/v1/ml/sentiment

TrainTaskClassifier.summary: Trains the task classifier from a list of labelled problem/taskType pairs (minimum 10 samples required). POST https://api.web6.oasisomniverse.one/v1/ml/train

History.summary: Returns the last N telemetry events (default 50, max 500) — per-request provider, model, latency, token count, cost, FAHRN mode, BRAID graph reuse, avatar context injection, cache hits and loop detection. GET https://api.web6.oasisomniverse.one/v1/telemetry/history

GetUsage.summary: Returns current month spend (USD) and today's token count against configured limits for the authenticated avatar. GET https://api.web6.oasisomniverse.one/v1/usage

Status.summary: Returns the last-known health and latency for every configured AI provider. Results are cached for 60 seconds; pass ?refresh=true to force an immediate re-ping. GET https://api.web6.oasisomniverse.one/v1/providers/status

SendTask.summary: Submit a task to the OASIS FAHRN agent via the Google A2A protocol. Runs FAHRN solve async and returns an A2ATask with status. POST https://api.web6.oasisomniverse.one/a2a/tasks/send

GetTask.summary: Get A2A task status by id. GET https://api.web6.oasisomniverse.one/a2a/tasks/{id}

CancelTask.summary: Cancel a running A2A task. POST https://api.web6.oasisomniverse.one/a2a/tasks/{id}/cancel
